Train a TabICL classification model

Source: R/tabicl.R
tab_icl_classification.Rd

Train a TabICL classification model

Usage

tab_icl_classification(
  X,
  y,
  n_estimators = 8,
  norm_methods = NULL,
  feat_shuffle_method = "latin",
  class_shuffle_method = "shift",
  outlier_threshold = 4,
  softmax_temperature = 0.9,
  average_logits = TRUE,
  support_many_classes = TRUE,
  batch_size = 8,
  model_path = NULL,
  allow_auto_download = TRUE,
  checkpoint_version = "tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt",
  device = "auto",
  use_amp = "auto",
  use_fa3 = "auto",
  offload_mode = "auto",
  disk_offload_dir = NULL,
  random_state = 42,
  n_jobs = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE,
  inference_config = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

X

Predictor data frame or matrix

y

Response vector (factor or character)

n_estimators

Number of ensemble members (default: 8). More = better but slower.

norm_methods

Normalization methods to try (default: NULL uses ["none", "power"]).

feat_shuffle_method

Feature permutation strategy (default: "latin").

class_shuffle_method

Class permutation strategy (default: "shift").

outlier_threshold

Z-score threshold for outlier detection and clipping (default: 4.0).

softmax_temperature

Temperature to control prediction confidence (default: 0.9).

average_logits

Average logits (TRUE) or probabilities (FALSE) (default: TRUE).

support_many_classes

Handle >10 classes automatically (default: TRUE).

batch_size

Batch size for ensemble processing (default: 8). Lower to save memory.

model_path

Path to checkpoint (default: NULL downloads from Hugging Face).

allow_auto_download

Auto-download checkpoint if not found locally (default: TRUE).

checkpoint_version

Pretrained checkpoint version (default: "tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt").

device

Device to use: "auto", "cpu", or "cuda" (default: "auto").

use_amp

Automatic mixed precision for faster inference (default: "auto").

use_fa3

Flash Attention 3 for Hopper GPUs (default: "auto").

offload_mode

Automatically decide when to use cpu/disk offloading (default: "auto").

disk_offload_dir

Directory for disk offloading (default: NULL).

random_state

Random seed for reproducibility (default: 42).

n_jobs

Number of PyTorch threads for CPU inference (default: NULL).

verbose

Print detailed information during inference (default: FALSE).

inference_config

Fine-grained inference control for advanced users (default: NULL).

...

Additional arguments passed to TabICLClassifier

Value

A tab_icl model object with mode = "classification"
